The balance sheet is moderately leveraged but still supported by a solid equity base (equity ≈ 40% of assets) and acceptable liquidity (current ratio 1.30), while very large retained earnings suggest an established business. However, operating profitability is thin (EBIT margin about 4.4%, EBIT/assets about 2.0%), which limits resilience and points to the low end of investment-grade credit quality.

DECISION: BBB-
